name: Event e Ikou! Sono 7
original_name: イベントへ行こう!その7
source:
Go to a convention, and have sex with a cosplayer!
A must-see girl who becomes your favorite character, as though she's coming out of the product to you!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ092410.html]DLsite[/url]]

Features [url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=character&charid=2076]Ryomou Shimei[/url] from Ikkitousen.
translation:
去漫展和cosplayer做爱吧！化身为心仪角色的女孩们，仿佛从作品中走出来一样，不容错过！

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ092410.html]DLsite[/url]]

收录了《一骑当千》中的[url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=character&charid=2076]吕蒙子明[/url]。
